jp: 死んじゃイヤだ・・・
en: Johannes... Don't die...
Cain... Cain.
Uuh... Johannes, don't go..
I am right here, Cain.
...Huh?
...Johannes!!

jp: 死に損なってしまったようだな
en: ...It seems I have failed to die.
Thank goodness.. You're awake.

jp: どこにもケガはないか？
en: ...Cain. You are not hurt anywhere?
I'm fine.
Everyone else is fine too.
That is good.
And Matia?
...I see.

jp: うまくいかなかったのか・・・
en: It did not go well, then...
I'm sorry, Johannes. I...
I... I've been thinking about it this whole time.

jp: ヨハネが目を覚ましたら
en: That when you woke up, I'd apologize properly!!!
Cain...

jp: ずっと起きないから・・・
en: But you... you just wouldn't wake up...

jp: ボクは怖かった・・・
このまま、ヨハネがいなくなって
しまうんじゃないかって・・・
en: I was scared... That you'd slip away, just like that...
I was so scared...

jp: お前が必要としてくれる限り
私はそばに居るよ・・・
en: As long as you need me, I will be at your side...

jp: 必要でなくなったその時は・・
en: But one day, when you no longer need me..

jp: 消えてしまうみたいなこと
en: Don't talk like you're going to vanish, not at a time like this!
...Forgive me.

jp: でも、覚えておくんだよ
en: But remember this, Cain.

jp: 子供はいつか巣立つものだ
en: Children leave the nest one day.

jp: 私から離れなくてはならない
en: Someday you, too, will have to leave my side.

jp: ボクが大人になったら・・・
ヨハネとはもう会えなくなるの？
en: When I grow up... I won't be able to see you anymore?

jp: 私はキミに自立して欲しい
en: I want you to stand on your own.

jp: 自分の頭で考えて欲しい
en: To walk on your own feet, see with your own eyes, think with your own head.

jp: 困ったときの相談役くらいは
en: Naturally, I will still serve as counsel when you are in trouble.
For that, you must first graduate from being Cain the crybaby.

jp: な、泣いてなんかないよ！
en: I-I'm not crying!

jp: フフフッ、目が赤い・・・
en: Heh heh. Your eyes are red...

jp: カインはすぐに顔に出る
これも直した方が良さそうだ
en: It shows on your face right away, Cain. We had best fix that as well.
Uuuuuugh...

jp: ヨハネなんてもう知らない！！
en: Johannes, you idiot! I'm done with you!!

jp: カインに見捨てられちまったぜ？
en: Aw man, Johannes-san. Looks like Cain's given up on you, huh?

jp: どうやら、そのようだな
en: So it would seem.

jp: そんなに可愛いんならあんたも
素直にかまってやればいいのに
en: ...Good grief. If he's that dear to you, just dote on him and be done with it.

jp: 今のはちょっと意地悪だったよ
en: That was a bit mean just now.
Heh.

jp: 意外とアイツこういうの根に持つ
en: Yeah~ Surprisingly, that guy's the type to hold a grudge over stuff like this.

jp: この前だってさ～・・・
en: Just the other day~...

jp: まだこんな所にいたのか？
ヴァルトス様が・・・
en: Exal! You're still hanging around here? Valtoss-sama is...
I know, I know!! I'm coming!!

jp: 確かサイファーパンクの
リーダーの名前だったか？
en: Valtoss... That was the name of Cypherpunk's leader, was it not?

jp: 姿を見せないんだけどさ、
近々帰って来るそうなんだ
en: Yeah. He hardly ever shows his face, but word is he's coming back soon.

jp: 俺はちょっと本業の方に戻るよ
en: Gotta prep for that, so I'm heading back to my real job for a bit. Rest is on you.
Mm.

jp: あんまりカインをいじめるなよ
ひねくれた子供に育っても
en: Don't pick on Cain too much. Don't blame me if he grows up all twisted, got it?
Heh heh. Understood.

jp: ヨハネさんの面倒よろしくな
en: Auntie, you look after Johannes-san too.

jp: 何せ放浪癖って話だし
こんな状態で外に出したら
en: He's got that wandering habit. Let him out in this state and Cain'll be furious.

jp: 誰がおばちゃんだって？
en: Who are you calling Auntie?

jp: 怒るとせっかくの美人が
en: Ahahaha! Get angry and you'll ruin that pretty face, you know?

jp: それじゃあ、行ってきます！！！
en: Well then, I'm off!!
Hey, Exal!! Get back here!!

jp: 甘えグセが抜けてないんだから
en: ...Honestly. That boy still hasn't outgrown his clingy ways.

jp: まんざらでもなさそうに
en: You do not seem to mind much.

jp: 手のかかる子ほど可愛いものさ
en: The more trouble a child gives you, the dearer they are.

jp: いつか巣立つものなら
なおさら今が愛おしいよ
en: If they're bound to leave the nest someday, that makes now all the more precious.

jp: カインも私の手元を去る
en: Yes. Someday, Cain too will surely leave my side.
And before that time comes, I......
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
